name: sethiddenproperty
description: Sets a Roblox property using reflection metadata, including properties that are not scriptable. Returns whether the property was hidden before the successful write.

parameters.name: instance
parameters.description: Instance whose property should be written.

parameters.name: property
parameters.description: Property name resolved through Roblox property metadata.

parameters.name: value
parameters.description: Value to write. The accepted type depends on the property's reflection type.
